components.name: Button
components.description: Neutral action with the built hover, disabled and keyboard-focus treatments.

components.name: Temporal Navigation
components.description: The report's pressed-state navigation; selected and unselected specimens retain their authored hover and compact-layout treatments.
components.css: .ds-lanes { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--charcoal, #1e1c18); } .ds-lane { font: 15px/1.5 "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #252722); background: var(--sheet, #ffffff); min-height: 42px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #c8ccd0); border-bottom: 0; border-radius: 3px 3px 0 0; margin-right: 5px; padding: 11px 15px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-lane[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--yellow, #fbc807); color: var(--charcoal, #1e1c18); border-color: var(--charcoal, #1e1c18); font-weight: 650; } .ds-lane:hover { background: #e8e9e8; } .ds-lane[aria-pressed="true"]:hover { background: #efbe06; } .ds-lane:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #155da4); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-lane span { margin-left: 7px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } @media (max-width: 620px) { .ds-lanes { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 7px; border: 0; } .ds-lane { margin: 0; border: 1px solid var(--line, #c8ccd0); border-radius: 3px; font-size: 13px; min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 8px; } }

components.css: .ds-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 5px; } .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font: 650 12px/1.5 "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 3px 7px; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-incident { background: var(--incident-wash, #fceeea); color: var(--incident, #9b2f27); } .ds-maintenance, .ds-partial { background: var(--maintenance-wash, #fff1da); color: var(--maintenance, #854a09); } .ds-info { background: var(--info-wash, #eaf3f8); color: var(--info, #1e5b75); } .ds-unknown { background: var(--unknown-wash, #eceef1); color: var(--unknown, #535b67); }

narrative.overview:
The built system is a readable yellow/charcoal customer frame around flat neutral evidence sheets. Its character is compact, practical and restrained: branding establishes identity, typography organizes reading, and independently named evidence colors distinguish states without painting the whole workpaper yellow.

The generic presentation keeps CLIENTE and an empty Customer logo frame. The supplied, source-sampled identity colors are visual authority, not an official customer brand specification; the same readable identity applies to generic Git and authorized private rendering. This document records the built `report_template.html`, not a live capture or source-acceptance result. `SURFACE.md` retains the local task sequence and composition decisions; those are not global design tokens.
keyCharacteristics: Sparse yellow branding and selected navigation; charcoal text on yellow.
White, thin-bordered sheets on a pale neutral field; no shadows.
Native system type for reading, wrapping monospace for receipts.
Explicit text labels alongside independent evidence-state colors.
Visible keyboard focus and responsive evidence access.

rules.name: The Dark-on-Yellow Rule
rules.body: Use charcoal lettering on yellow identity and selected-navigation surfaces, never white lettering.

rules.name: The Separate Semantics Rule
rules.body: Yellow identifies branding and selection; evidence states retain their named foreground/wash pairs and explicit text labels.

rules.name: The Reading-and-Receipts Rule
rules.body: Use the native sans-serif for reading and controls, and wrapping monospace for identifiers and original records.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: Separate work areas with neutral surfaces and fine rules rather than shadow elevation.

dos: Do use yellow sparsely for branding and pressed navigation, with charcoal lettering.
Do pair incident, maintenance, information and Unknown foregrounds with their matching washes and explicit labels.
Do keep evidence sheets flat and reserve monospace for records and identifiers.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, native controls and focus transfer to the refreshed dossier.
Do retain wrapping, disclosures and local table scrolling in compact layouts instead of dropping evidence.
donts: Don't put white lettering on yellow.
Don't recolor all evidence yellow or replace Unknown with a reassuring success color.
Don't embed real customer branding in the generic CLIENTE name or empty Customer logo frame.
Don't promote the local temporal strategy, composition choice or surface seed into global design tokens.
Don't describe these source-sampled colors as an official customer brand specification or this template as live evidence.
